config._comment_wp_3_6: Default action stays false (don't force on every new user). Admin/staff get a forced enrollment prompt on first login via the 'AISHA MFA Factor' flow's userSetupAllowed=true — Keycloak attaches CONFIGURE_TOTP or webauthn-register required action automatically when the flow demands a factor the user doesn't yet have.

authenticationFlows.description: First broker login: a new e-mail creates a user; an existing account is linked only after its owner confirms and proves it (e-mail or password). No auto-link. See docs/deploy/OAUTH_PROVIDERS.md
Create the user when the brokered e-mail is new; otherwise the owner must confirm and verify the existing account (no silent linking).
Existing account: the owner confirms the link, then proves ownership (e-mail or password).
Prove ownership of the existing account: e-mail link (needs realm SMTP) or re-authentication with its password.
Re-authenticate the existing account with its password (and OTP when configured).
OTP when the existing account has it configured.
Phase 12 WP 3.6 — force MFA factor for users with the admin role. Conditional sub-flow skips silently for non-admin users.
Phase 12 WP 3.6 — force MFA factor for users with the staff role. Conditional sub-flow skips silently for non-staff users.
Phase 12 WP 3.6 — second-factor choice (WebAuthn preferred, TOTP fallback). Shared by admin + staff conditional sub-flows.
